Leave NVL and CPL unchanged so they have no winter_kit setting.", "uses": ["R1"], "after": []}, {"id": "P2", "file": "allocation/rations.py", "change": "Add winter_kits(household: Household, today=None) -> int. Look up the household's region settings with config.settings.region(household.region) (household.region is the region code string, per R4). If the returned settings dict has no 'winter_kit' key, return 0. Otherwise compute the effective people count by reusing the existing ration_size(household, today) (with day = today or _today(), same pattern as food_kits), take people_per_kit from the region's winter_kit setting, and return max(1, math.floor(ration_size(household, today) / people_per_kit)) so every household in a winter_kit region gets at least one kit. Decide only by the presence of the winter_kit setting, not by climate.", "uses": ["R2", "R3", "R4", "R7"], "after": ["P1"]}, {"id": "P3", "file": "inventory/stock.py", "change": "Add reserve_winter_kits(warehouse_id: str, qty: int, household_id: str). If qty == 0, return None without calling reserve_stock (reserve_stock raises ValueError for qty <= 0, so the zero check must happen here). Otherwise return reserve_stock(warehouse_id, 'WINTER-KIT', qty, 72, household_id=household_id), which validates the SKU (WINTER-KIT is already in config.settings.SKUS), applies the 72-hour hold, records the reservation in the ledger, and returns the Reservation.", "uses": ["R5", "R6", "R8"], "after": []}]}}

P1: config/regions.yaml — add winter_kit: people_per_kit: 3 to HGL (cold region). Only HGL is cold per R1. uses R1.

P2: allocation/rations.py — add winter_kits(household, today=None). Read region settings via config.settings.region(household.region); if no winter_kit setting return 0; else people = ration_size(household, today); kits = max(1, floor(people / people_per_kit)). uses R2, R3, R4.

P3: inventory/stock.py — add reserve_winter_kits(warehouse_id, qty, household_id): if qty == 0 return None; else return reserve_stock(warehouse_id, 'WINTER-KIT', qty, 72, household_id=household_id). uses R5, R6, R8.
